description: Nose section only, first flown January 1979 and withdrawn at Middle Wallop by December 2009; sold in 2010, reduced to a nose section at Hixon and fitted out as the Lynx simulator at the Sim2do flight-simulator centre, which is seen by booked visitors. Last recorded present August 2017; the Lynx simulator was still advertised by the business in 2025-26.
museum_name: Sim2do Flight Simulators Lynx Nose, Mildenhall
